q4: Cat versus dog. One near-boundary cat was predicted as dog at a score of -0.001. Its upright pose and tan face resemble cues visible in the dog support vectors. Another cat stayed on the correct side at +0.002. The black dog predicted as bird also shows how the final multiclass vote can differ from a single pair's score.

Automobile versus truck. The red car and the white box truck landed on opposite wrong sides at about -0.004 and +0.004. The training support vectors include crops dominated by a wheel or a front grille. At this resolution, those shapes can be shared across vehicle classes.

Bird versus deer. The small bird among branches scored nearly zero and was predicted as deer. The deer support vector is also a small subject against a much larger background. The close scores indicate overlap along this decision function in the fixed 216-value CNN representation.
